video_history.why: No video or Demand Gen ads ran in the last 90 days, so there is no hook or hold rate to read. The scripts lean on the search terms and ad lines.

evidence.window_note: 90 days hold 100+ visible clicks, so the window wasn't widened
evidence.excluded_terms: 3 terms left out (brand, another firm's name, job seekers); not quoted

descriptions.line: Read 1,200 reviews from homeowners near you, then book in under a minute.
Furnace out? Our heating techs fix most problems in one visit. Book a same-day slot.
No heat at night? A licensed tech can be at your door tonight, with no overtime fee.
We repair every furnace brand. Open 7 days across the Denver metro.
Call and talk to a live dispatcher, day or night, across the Denver metro.

claims_inventory.claim: most repairs done in one visit

evidence.claims_flags: none: no two lines state different numbers for the same thing, and every line in these ads is about heating

scripts.name: Script A: the cold-air problem
scripts.angle: Name the problem people type ('the problem itself', 20 conversions), then answer the price worry. 'local and near me' leads with 36 conversions, but it names a place, not a reason to call, so it goes into the on-screen text as Denver.
evidence: 'the problem itself' searches: 6 terms, 160 clicks, 20 conversions
top headline: 'Furnace Repair in Denver' (9.8 conversions per 1,000 impressions)

beats.voiceover: Furnace blowing cold air? We can fix it today.
beats.visual: Tech at a basement furnace, van with the logo behind
beats.on_screen_text: FURNACE BLOWING COLD AIR? | Example Home Services, Denver

beats.voiceover: Most furnaces that quit on a cold night need one part, not a new system.
beats.visual: Close-up of the tech finding the fault

beats.voiceover: We tell you the price before we start, and there's never an overtime charge.
beats.visual: Tech showing the homeowner a price on a tablet

beats.voiceover: Homeowners rate us 4.9 stars from 1,200 reviews.
beats.visual: Review stars over a warm living room
Phone booking screen, then the van pulling up

hook_variants.evidence: the problem theme leads the search terms

hook_variants.hook: First cold night and the furnace quit?
Don't replace your furnace before you read this price.
hook_variants.evidence: cost and payment searches; the upfront-price line

scripts.name: Script B: no heat tonight
scripts.angle: Speed: the heat back today, with the price first.
evidence: 'same-day' lines carry the most conversions per impression among the heating headlines

beats.visual: Breath visible in a cold room
beats.direction: hook lands in 1 second, sound off

beats.visual: Tech at the door with a toolbag
Tablet with the price, thumbs up

hook_variants.hook: One cold night can freeze your pipes.

production_notes.script_a: One basement setup with practical light, plus 3 b-roll shots (the fault close-up, the tablet price, the van). Captions burned in, large, high contrast.
production_notes.script_b: Phone-shot, 9:16. Keep text inside the middle 4:5 area so Reels buttons don't cover it. Captions on every line.
production_notes.both: Shoot on one day. Use real reviews only. No other company's name or equipment brand on screen.

test_plan.test: Script A against a cut that opens with hook variant 2
test_plan.where: YouTube (a Video or Demand Gen campaign)
test_plan.deciding_metric: 25% quartile rate first, then cost per conversion
test_plan.read_after: 1,000+ impressions per version for the hook
test_plan.read_with: job A of this skill on the Google Ads video results

test_plan.test: Script B with its 3 hook variants as separate ads
test_plan.read_with: job A of this skill once Meta is connected

checklist.item: the first second works with the sound off
the hook fits the placement's window
one message runs through the whole script
the setup uses the audience's own words
the product is shown working, not described
every claim is in the inventory
the brand appears in time for the placement
spoken words stay within 2.5 per second
on-screen text carries the story without sound
a test plan with a deciding metric

compliance: Home services aren't one of the regulated categories here; still check whether your trade license number must appear in ads where you operate.
next: After 1,000+ impressions per version, run job A on the YouTube and Meta results.
